summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting a contract award from Tawazun Council for the UAE Air Force to procure up to 20 C-390 Millennium aircraft (10 firm + 10 options). This is a routine sales contract disclosure for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No shareholder vote, advisor, premium, or structural mechanics relevant to mergers, acquisitions, or other special categories are involved. The filing reflects ordinary business operations, so mapping to a U.S. equivalent of a press release. What to watch: order conversion of options and ongoing support agreements.
